# Περιγραφικά χαρακτηριστικά ασθενών

Ο Πίνακας 1 παρουσιάζει τα περιγραφικά χαρακτηριστικά όλων των ασθενών. Κάθε
ασθενής περιλαμβάνεται μία φορά, καθώς οι ίδιοι ασθενείς αξιολογήθηκαν τόσο με
όσο και χωρίς φυσικοθεραπεία.

```{r}
db_path <- fs::path("data.duckdb")

if (!fs::file_exists(path = db_path)) {
  rlang::abort(
    message = stringr::str_c(
      "Δεν βρέθηκε το αρχείο data.duckdb στον",
      "ριζικό κατάλογο του έργου.",
      sep = " "
    )
  )
}

connection <- DBI::dbConnect(
  drv = duckdb::duckdb(),
  dbdir = db_path,
  read_only = TRUE
)

query_result <- tryCatch(
  expr = list(
    patient_data = DBI::dbGetQuery(
      conn = connection,
      statement = stringr::str_c(
        "SELECT",
        "p.patient_id,",
        "ia.age_years,",
        "ia.height_cm,",
        "ia.weight_kg,",
        "ia.apache_ii_score,",
        "ia.sex,",
        "ia.admission_reason,",
        "ia.mechanical_ventilation_indication,",
        "ia.mechanical_ventilation_days,",
        "ia.icu_stay_days,",
        "ia.icu_outcome,",
        "ia.hospital_outcome",
        "FROM patients AS p",
        "INNER JOIN icu_admissions AS ia",
        "ON p.patient_id = ia.patient_id",
        "ORDER BY p.patient_id",
        sep = " "
      )
    ),
    comorbidities = DBI::dbGetQuery(
      conn = connection,
      statement = stringr::str_c(
        "SELECT patient_id, comorbidity_type, source_value",
        "FROM patient_comorbidities",
        "ORDER BY patient_id, comorbidity_type",
        sep = " "
      )
    )
  ),
  finally = DBI::dbDisconnect(
    conn = connection,
    shutdown = TRUE
  )
)

patient_data <- query_result$patient_data
comorbidities <- query_result$comorbidities
```

## Πίνακας 1

```{r}
parse_numeric <- function(values) {
  normalized_values <- values |>
    stringr::str_squish() |>
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      pattern = ",",
      replacement = "."
    ) |>
    dplyr::na_if(y = "")

  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(x = normalized_values)
  )
}

format_number <- function(value, digits = 1L) {
  formatC(
    x = value,
    format = "f",
    digits = digits,
    decimal.mark = ","
  )
}

format_n_percent <- function(count, denominator, digits = 1L) {
  percentage <- format_number(
    value = 100 * count / denominator,
    digits = digits
  )

  stringr::str_c(
    count,
    " (",
    percentage,
    "%)"
  )
}

translate_categories <- function(values) {
  trimmed_values <- values |>
    stringr::str_squish()
  normalized_values <- trimmed_values |>
    stringr::str_to_lower()

  dplyr::case_when(
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "male",
      "m",
      "άνδρας",
      "ανδρας",
      "άρρεν",
      "αρρεν"
    ) ~ "Άνδρας",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "female",
      "f",
      "γυναίκα",
      "γυναικα",
      "θήλυ",
      "θηλυ"
    ) ~ "Γυναίκα",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "alive",
      "survived",
      "survivor",
      "επιβίωση",
      "επιβιωση",
      "επιβίωσε",
      "επιβιωσε"
    ) ~ "Επιβίωση",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "dead",
      "deceased",
      "death",
      "θάνατος",
      "θανατος",
      "απεβίωσε",
      "απεβιωσε"
    ) ~ "Θάνατος",
    TRUE ~ trimmed_values
  )
}

translate_binary_categories <- function(values) {
  trimmed_values <- values |>
    stringr::str_squish()
  normalized_values <- trimmed_values |>
    stringr::str_to_lower()

  dplyr::case_when(
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "yes",
      "y",
      "true",
      "1",
      "ναι"
    ) ~ "Ναι",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "no",
      "n",
      "false",
      "0",
      "όχι",
      "οχι"
    ) ~ "Όχι",
    TRUE ~ trimmed_values
  )
}

summarise_continuous <- function(label, values) {
  numeric_values <- parse_numeric(values = values)
  available_values <- numeric_values[!is.na(numeric_values)]
  missing_count <- sum(is.na(numeric_values))

  if (length(available_values) == 0L) {
    summary_text <- "Μη διαθέσιμα"
  } else {
    quartiles <- stats::quantile(
      x = available_values,
      probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    )
    summary_text <- stringr::str_c(
      format_number(value = quartiles[[2L]]),
      " [",
      format_number(value = quartiles[[1L]]),
      ", ",
      format_number(value = quartiles[[3L]]),
      "]"
    )
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    variable = label,
    summary = stringr::str_c(
      summary_text,
      "; ελλείποντα: ",
      missing_count
    )
  )
}

summarise_categorical <- function(label, values) {
  translated_values <- translate_categories(values = values)
  translated_values <- dplyr::if_else(
    condition = is.na(translated_values) | translated_values == "",
    true = "Μη διαθέσιμο",
    false = translated_values
  )

  counts <- tibble::tibble(category = translated_values) |>
    dplyr::count(
      category,
      name = "count",
      sort = FALSE
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      display = purrr::map_chr(
        .x = .data$count,
        .f = function(count) {
          format_n_percent(
            count = count,
            denominator = n_patients
          )
        }
      )
    )

  tibble::tibble(
    variable = label,
    summary = counts$category |>
      stringr::str_c(
        ": ",
        counts$display,
        collapse = "; "
      )
  )
}

n_patients <- dplyr::n_distinct(patient_data$patient_id)

continuous_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Ηλικία (έτη)",
    values = patient_data$age_years
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Ύψος (cm)",
    values = patient_data$height_cm
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Βάρος (kg)",
    values = patient_data$weight_kg
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Βαθμολογία APACHE II",
    values = patient_data$apache_ii_score
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Ημέρες μηχανικού αερισμού",
    values = patient_data$mechanical_ventilation_days
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Ημέρες παραμονής στη ΜΕΘ",
    values = patient_data$icu_stay_days
  )
)

categorical_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "Φύλο",
    values = patient_data$sex
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "Αιτία εισαγωγής στη ΜΕΘ",
    values = patient_data$admission_reason
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "Ένδειξη μηχανικού αερισμού",
    values = patient_data$mechanical_ventilation_indication
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "Έκβαση στη ΜΕΘ",
    values = patient_data$icu_outcome
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "Ενδονοσοκομειακή έκβαση",
    values = patient_data$hospital_outcome
  )
)

comorbidity_labels <- c(
  copd = "Χρόνια αποφρακτική πνευμονοπάθεια (ΧΑΠ)",
  restrictiveLungDisease = "Περιοριστική πνευμονοπάθεια",
  neuromuscularDisease = "Νευρομυϊκή νόσος",
  heartFailure = "Καρδιακή ανεπάρκεια",
  diabetes = "Σακχαρώδης διαβήτης",
  previousStroke = "Προηγούμενο αγγειακό εγκεφαλικό επεισόδιο",
  vascularDisease = "Γνωστή αγγειακή νόσος",
  chronicKidneyDisease = "Χρόνια νεφρική νόσος",
  otherUnderlyingCondition = "Άλλη υποκείμενη νόσος"
)

comorbidity_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(
  .x = names(comorbidity_labels),
  .f = function(comorbidity_code) {
    values <- comorbidities |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$comorbidity_type == .env$comorbidity_code
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(var = "source_value") |>
      translate_binary_categories()

    summarise_categorical(
      label = unname(comorbidity_labels[[comorbidity_code]]),
      values = values
    )
  }
)

table_1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    variable = "Συνολικός αριθμός ασθενών",
    summary = stringr::str_c(n_patients)
  ),
  continuous_rows,
  categorical_rows,
  comorbidity_rows
)
```
